title: Improved pseudorandom generators for constant-depth circuits

license.adaptation_notice: Faithful editable TeX transcription of the official CC BY4.0 main Theorem1, complete Section4 partitioning/hybrid construction and stronger Theorem10 proof, complete Sections5/6 switching and multi-switching proofs including Algorithms1--4 and all witness/searcher/decoupling continuations. Required author definitions, exact cited standard CNF PRG/hash facts and full bibliography retained. Only the formal published version is used; arxiv2301.10102 and Berkeley report are identity aliases, not content sources. Literal published expressions and numbering preserved; no mathematical corrections, added assumptions or new proofs. All supporting switching/partition results and bottom-width parameter refinement are grouped with the main PRG result.

core_obligations: Preserve seed/error/depth/circuit-size conditions and full main construction.
Retain all original canonical-query algorithms, witnesses, searchers, decoupling and CNF tests in the two switching proofs.
Do not split supporting switching lemmas, partition framework or bottom-width parameter refinement.
difficulty_reason: The author partitions variables with bounded independence and combines lower-depth generators through a hybrid argument. Full derandomization of multi-switching uses partial witnesses, random-advice searchers and decoupling; CNF tests then transfer the random-restriction analysis to pseudorandom assigned bits without the extra logarithmic seed factor.

Main PRG and all switching/partition support and parameter refinements remain one claim group.
